passenger_response.subject: Update on your disrupted booking AER-5C9X3T
passenger_response.body:
Dear Greg Whitmore,

Our record shows that flight AK229 on 2026-08-05 was cancelled because the operating crew were out of hours following a previous-day disruption, and no standby crew were available at LHR.

We have found you a seat but we have not confirmed it. It carries an additional fare, which someone senior has to approve before we can book it. They have the details.

We cannot work out compensation yet. It depends on how late you actually arrive at your final destination, and that is not known until your new flight has run. It will be assessed then. Do not read this as a decision either way.

As the flight was cancelled, you are entitled to care while this is being resolved. This includes meals and refreshments up to GBP 30 per passenger per 6 hours, two calls or equivalent, a hotel up to GBP 180 per room per night for up to 3 nights subject to station allocation, and transport up to GBP 45 per journey.

Your request to stop marketing messages has been addressed. Your requests about adding a checked bag, investigating a duplicate charge, choosing an aisle seat, whether AK229 would operate, cancelling the booking for a full refund, and withdrawing the earlier refund request had already been dealt with in the contact.

Regards,
Aerlink Disruption Desk
